name: Creditor
overview: Scripture provides clear guidance on the responsibilities and conduct of creditors, emphasizing mercy and fairness. The laws concerning Hebrew servants illustrate the limits on servitude, ensuring freedom after six years unless the servant chooses to remain, highlighting a balance between justice and compassion. Additionally, lending to the poor must be done without charging interest, forbidding exploitation and oppression. These instructions reveal God's heart for merciful treatment within financial and servitude relationships.
